story: Barry was born on August 20, 2011, and filled fifteen years with energy, stubbornness, and love. Small in size but enormous in spirit, she was every bit a Jack Russell.
She was part of every ordinary day, and those days became our most treasured memories.

timeline.text: On October 4, she crossed the rainbow bridge.

content.tribute: Until we meet again at the end of the rainbow bridge, run free, sweet girl.
